svg.title: Sunny Beach layout
svg.text: SUNNY BEACH · Sunny Beach · 48x28 tiles · road 3.5 tiles wide
Lap 98 tiles = 12,580 px · about 15 s per lap · closest the road comes to itself: 10.8 tiles
Dashed white = racing line. Pink = mid-lap checkpoint. Pale blue on the road = ice. Orange = boost pad.
Kerbs wherever the bend is tight. Map edge is a wall. One faint square = one 128 px tile.
